descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在里斯本尝过的蛋挞，旁边画了一小片像逗号的酥皮。肉桂粉是我给自己这份添的。
descriptions.en: The pastel de nata I tried in Lisbon, with a comma-shaped flake on my menu. The cinnamon was my choice for that serving.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在里斯本吃过鳕鱼午饭后留下的菜单。菜名分开写了几段，叉子终于等到了自己的那一段。
descriptions.en: My menu after a salt-cod lunch in Lisbon. I spaced out the dish's name; the waiting fork eventually got its turn.

names.en: River at One End, Arch at the Other

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在里斯本商业广场说“那一边”没说清楚后，我记下的两个地标。只为保存自己的碰面回忆。
descriptions.en: Two landmarks I noted after “over there” failed us at Lisbon's Praça do Comércio. A keepsake of my own meeting.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在里斯本吃蛋挞时落到盘边的一小片酥皮，我后来把它画成逗号。袋里收的是这张干净便纸。
descriptions.en: A flake beside my Lisbon custard tart became a drawn comma. This clean note is what came away in my bag.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 参观里斯本海洋馆时，我在玻璃上认出自己的邮包倒影，后来把它记在这张小纸上。
descriptions.en: A little record of spotting my own mailbag reflected in the glass at Lisbon's Oceanarium, apparently waiting for a letter.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 把河与拱门分放两头的自制折卡，中间是我在里斯本那次歇脚的小点，不是导航地图。
descriptions.en: My homemade Lisbon fold card, with river and arch at its ends and a dot for one personal pause between them. It is not a navigation map.
